subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: The Cotton Gin: Mechanizing Agriculture
description: One-minute skill: The Cotton Gin: Mechanizing Agriculture.

hook.text: Separating cotton seeds from fiber by hand took all day. A machine changed that.

buildup.text: Eli Whitney's gin used a drum with hooks to pull fiber through a mesh.

discovery.text: Seeds were too big to pass the mesh. Clean fiber came out the other side.

twist.text: The gin made cotton hugely profitable but tragically expanded slave labor.

climax.text: One machine reshaped agriculture, textiles, and the course of a nation.

punchline.text: A simple drum solved a hard problem — and created new ones.

quiz.question: What unintended consequence did the cotton gin cause?
options: It made cotton farming unprofitable in the South
By making cotton hugely profitable, it expanded demand for slave labor
It caused widespread unemployment among textile factory workers
